_doc: Corpus registry for the MODEH organ. Read-only descriptors: where a corpus lives, how a filename yields its LABEL and its GROUP (recording session / speaker / TTS seed), and which label pairs are the SAME PHONE and therefore must NOT be separable. Adding a corpus here is the only thing needed to judge it.
_expect: 'expect' is what the HUMAN record already says. It is written down so the organ can be scored against it, and it is NEVER read by the scoring code.
identical_phones_default: tav vs tet -- both /t/ in modern Hebrew
kaf vs qof -- both /k/ in modern Hebrew
alef vs ayin -- both a bare /a/ in modern Hebrew
